title: From First Idea to Finished Song

parts.title: Start Making Songs
parts.summary: Protect and capture a musical idea, use repetition deliberately, and finish a complete miniature.

parts.title: Rhythm and Groove
parts.summary: Set a useful pace, group the beat, make space, shape entrances, and coordinate a convincing groove.

parts.title: Notes, Keys, and Chords
parts.summary: Connect pitch distances, scales, tonal home, chords, and chord families before transposition and harmonic arrival.

parts.title: Melody and Hooks
parts.summary: Develop a motif into a singable phrase with a purposeful contour and a memorable focal feature.

parts.title: Lyrics and Meaning
parts.summary: Give a lyric a central situation, a speaker, specific images, useful sound, and a developing meaning.

parts.title: Bass Movement and Harmonic Color
parts.summary: Connect chord voices, direct the bass, and choose harmonic color or tonal change for a specific purpose.

parts.title: The Whole Song
parts.summary: Give sections distinct contributions, make recurring passages matter, and choose an effective whole-song route.

parts.title: Arrange, Revise, and Finish
parts.summary: Choose a sound setting, assign parts, shape energy and delivery, revise deliberately, and finish a clear version.
